draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 and T1.r2.lat=118 support the comparison. The hedge "may" is appropriate because the two latencies were measured on different hardware/precision (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), so a direct speed claim is not fully established. The sentence is appropriately scoped and hedged.
